mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_dag_node_attempt (dag_instance_id, node_instance_id, attempt_no, request_id, request_checksum, algorithm_code, worker_id, worker_address, worker_epoch, status, request_json, attempt_lease_version, attempt_lease_expire_time, execution_deadline_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{attempt.dagInstanceId}, #{attempt.nodeInstanceId}, #{attempt.attemptNo}, #{attempt.requestId}, #{attempt.requestChecksum}, #{attempt.algorithmCode}, #{attempt.workerId}, #{attempt.workerAddress}, #{attempt.workerEpoch}, 0, CAST(#{attempt.requestJson} AS JSONB), #{attempt.attemptLeaseVersion}, #{attempt.attemptLeaseExpireTime}, #{attempt.executionDeadlineAt}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_dag_node_attempt SET status = 10, dispatched_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 0
UPDATE sr_dag_node_attempt SET status = 20, accepted_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 10
UPDATE sr_dag_node_attempt SET status = 30, started_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 20

UPDATE sr_dag_node_attempt SET status = 40, result_json = CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSONB), result_ref = #{resultRef}, finished_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 30

UPDATE sr_dag_node_attempt SET status = 50, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 30
UPDATE sr_dag_node_attempt SET status = 70, finished_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 30
UPDATE sr_dag_node_attempt SET status = 80, finished_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status IN (10, 20, 30)
mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM sr_dag_node_attempt a WHERE a.status IN (10, 30, 80) AND a.execution_deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND a.execution_deadline_at <= NOW() ORDER BY a.execution_deadline_at, a.id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT a.id FROM sr_dag_node_attempt a WHERE a.status IN (10, 30, 80) AND a.attempt_lease_expire_time IS NOT NULL AND a.attempt_lease_expire_time < NOW() AND a.execution_deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND a.execution_deadline_at > NOW() ORDER BY a.attempt_lease_expire_time, a.id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT a.id FROM sr_dag_node_attempt a JOIN sr_dag_node_instance ni ON ni.id = a.node_instance_id WHERE a.status IN (40, 50, 70, 80) AND ni.status = 40 ORDER BY a.finished_at, a.id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT a.id FROM sr_dag_node_attempt a WHERE a.status = 80 AND a.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND (NOW() - a.finished_at) > ( 2 * COALESCE( (SELECT alg.timeout_seconds FROM sr_algorithm_definition alg WHERE alg.algorithm_code = a.algorithm_code), 300 ) ) ORDER BY a.finished_at, a.id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_dag_node_attempt SET status = 70, error_code = 'UNKNOWN_CONVERGE_TIMEOUT', error_message = 'UNKNOWN state converged to TIMEOUT after 2x timeout window', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 80
